title: Launcher Subsystem Dynamic Attributes
description: Dynamic attributes of the launcher subsystem, defining the muzzle locator, fire animation, and remaining ammo feedback outputs.

definition.description: Resource location of the subsystem model, pointing to the corresponding launcher subsystem static attribute definition file.

locator.description: Muzzle locator name. Projectiles are fired from the world transform of this locator.

fire_animation.description: Animation name played on fire, keyed in the part's animation set. Defaults to 'fire'. Same-name animations restart from 0; multiple launchers on the same part must use different names to avoid interrupting each other. A missing animation triggers a single warning and disables the fire animation.

ammo_outputs.description: Remaining ammo feedback output channels and targets. Optional.
